caseName: Youngberg v. Romeo ex rel. Romeo
caseNameFull: Youngberg, Superintendent, Pennhurst State School and Hospital v. Romeo, an incompetent, by his mother and next friend, Romeo

opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. Motion of respondent for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Motion of American Psychiatric Association for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari granted.
